name: OH-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent David Taylor running with over $1M raised
No polls or expert ratings; challenger has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The seat sits in a heavily Republican district, the incumbent is running and has raised about $1.1 million, and the Democratic challenger reports no fundraising. Prediction markets give the Republican roughly a 98% chance, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing the incumbent under 55% or significant outside spending against him would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
This southwestern Ohio seat is one of the most Republican-leaning districts in the country, with a partisan lean of about 21 points toward the GOP. First-term incumbent David Taylor is running for reelection after clearing his primary, and he has raised roughly $1.1 million with about $443,000 on hand. Democratic challenger Jennifer Mazzuckelli reports no fundraising figures, and no outside groups are active in the race on either side.

No public polls or expert race ratings are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and money. Prediction markets price the Republican at about 98%, and the fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit Republican margin. The race is rated Safe R.
